content.text:
I added the HelloAgentWorld view and a test for it. All 8 tests pass (`./mvnw test`): the 7 new ones plus the existing `ApplicationTest`.

**View:** `src/main/java/dev/vaadin/agentdemo/hello/ui/HelloAgentWorldView.java`, at `/hello-agent-world`
- It has a "Name" text field and a primary "Show" button. Pressing Enter also works.
- Clicking the button shows a success notification in the bottom right reading `Hello <name>!`. It closes after 5 seconds.
- **Empty input:** if the field is empty or only spaces, no notification appears. The field turns red with "Please enter a name" and gets focus. The error clears as soon as the user types. Spaces at the start and end of a name are removed before the greeting.
- **Navigation:** I added the view to the menu with `@Menu(title = "Hello Agent World", icon = "vaadin:hand")`. The existing `MainLayout` builds the side menu from these annotations, so it shows up there automatically.

**Test:** `src/test/java/dev/vaadin/agentdemo/hello/ui/HelloAgentWorldViewTest.java` runs the view without a browser and checks that:
- the button is primary
- the notification has the right text, position and success style
- extra spaces around the name are removed
- empty and space-only input show the error and no notification
- the error clears when the value changes
- the view is listed in the menu

I didn't start the app and look at the view in a browser.
